class Box<T> { v!: T; self(): this { return this; } }
function un<T>(b: Box<T>): T { return b.v; }
class NB extends Box<number> { z = 1 }
const n: number = un(new NB());
const s: string = un(new NB());
class A { add(): this { return this; } }
class B extends A { y = 2; }
const b: B = new A();
interface Fluent { set(k: string): this; }
const fl: Fluent = { set(k: string) { return this; } };
const wrong: Fluent = { set(k: string) { return 1; } };
class P { cmp(o: this): boolean { return true; } }
class Q { cmp(o: Q): boolean { return true; } }
const p: P = new Q();
const q: Q = new P();
console.log(n, s, b, fl, wrong, p, q);
